LanguageData.LP_GenasiFire.label: fire genasi
LanguageData.LP_GenasiFire.description: Human descendants with elemental fire in their veins. Fire genasi have skin like burnt ochre that's always warm to the touch; they can't be ignited, take half fire damage, and can flick sparks from their fingertips to ignite things within 6 cells. The price is fearing the cold and a fiery temper. The bloodline is passed on to children.
LanguageData.LP_GenasiFire.descriptionShort: Inheritable. Can't be ignited, half fire damage, heat-tolerant, can cast "Spark"; cold-sensitive, hot-tempered.
LanguageData.LP_GenasiWater.label: water genasi
LanguageData.LP_GenasiWater.description: Descendants of elemental water, with skin of a blue-green sheen and hair tips that are always wet. Water genasi walk through shallow water, marsh and shallow ocean as if on flat ground, and can summon a stream of water to put out fires and drench enemies. Their bodies are more delicate than others'. The bloodline is passed on to children.
LanguageData.LP_GenasiWater.descriptionShort: Inheritable. No slowdown in water, fairly cold-tolerant, can cast "Water stream" to put out fires and drench enemies; delicate constitution.
LanguageData.LP_GenasiEarth.label: earth genasi
LanguageData.LP_GenasiEarth.description: Descendants of elemental earth, with grey-brown skin like weathered rock; blunt blows land on them like on stone. Earth genasi are born to find ore and dig fast and clean, but walk heavily and learn slowly. No active ability. The bloodline is passed on to children.
LanguageData.LP_GenasiEarth.descriptionShort: Inheritable. Fast mining, high yield, blunt armor +15%; slightly slower, slow learners.
LanguageData.LP_GenasiAir.label: air genasi
LanguageData.LP_GenasiAir.description: Descendants of elemental air, with pale grey-blue skin and slender builds that walk with a breeze. Air genasi are fast and can leap on the wind to a visible spot 8 cells away; but their frames are thin and they're weak in melee. The bloodline is passed on to children.
LanguageData.LP_GenasiAir.descriptionShort: Inheritable. Move speed +10%, can "wind leap" to a visible spot within 8 cells; slender, poor at melee.
